title: Community & Ecosystem
concept: The XIOM community and ecosystem — where to find help, share projects, contribute, and stay connected with the XIOM developer community.
why: No language exists in isolation. The community provides support, packages, and the collective knowledge that makes a language thrive.
theory:
## The XIOM Community

### Where to Find Help

| Platform | Purpose | Link |
|----------|---------|------|
| Discord | Real-time chat, quick help | discord.gg/xiom-lang |
| Discourse Forum | In-depth discussions, announcements | discuss.xiom-lang.org |
| GitHub | Issues, PRs, code | github.com/xiom-lang |
| Reddit | Community discussion | r/xiom_lang |
| Stack Overflow | Q&A (tag: xiom) | stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/xiom |

### Community Projects

| Project | Category | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| xiom.actix | Web framework | High-performance web server |
| xiom.bevy | Game engine | ECS-based game engine |
| xiom.tokio | Async runtime | Async I/O framework |
| xiom.serde | Serialization | Generic serialization framework |
| xiom.clap | CLI | Command-line argument parser |
| xiom.ratatui | TUI | Terminal user interface library |

### Learning Resources

- **The XIOM Book**: docs.xiom-lang.org/book
- **XIOM by Example**: docs.xiom-lang.org/example
- **Standard Library Docs**: docs.xiom-lang.org/std
- **XIOM Playground**: play.xiom-lang.org
- **This course!**: Lessons L0-L8

### Events

- **XIOMConf**: Annual conference (talks, workshops, community)
- **XIOM Meetups**: Local user groups in major cities
- **Hackathons**: Build projects, win prizes, meet contributors

### Getting Involved

1. **Use XIOM**: Build projects, file bugs, request features
2. **Answer questions**: Help newcomers on Discord and forums
3. **Write documentation**: Improve docs, write tutorials, translate
4. **Create packages**: Publish useful libraries to the registry
5. **Contribute code**: Fix bugs, implement features in the compiler
6. **Organize events**: Start a local meetup, give talks
7. **Sponsor**: Financially support XIOM development

### Code of Conduct

The XIOM community is committed to providing a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free experience for everyone. Read the full Code of Conduct at xiom-lang.org/conduct.

### Staying Updated

- **Blog**: blog.xiom-lang.org (release announcements, team updates)
- **This Week in XIOM**: Weekly newsletter (this-week.xiom-lang.org)
- **Twitter/X**: @xiom_lang
- **YouTube**: XIOM Language channel (conference talks, tutorials)
- **Changelog**: github.com/xiom-lang/xiom/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

### The XIOM Foundation

XIOM is stewarded by the XIOM Foundation, an independent non-profit that:
- Manages the language's development and direction
- Organizes conferences and events
- Funds critical infrastructure and maintenance
- Protects the XIOM trademark and brand

tips: Join the Discord — it's the most active community hub
Don't be afraid to ask questions — everyone was a beginner once
The best way to learn is to build — start a project, share it, get feedback
Contributing to open source is the fastest way to become an expert
common_mistakes: Asking 'is anyone here?' in chat — just ask your question directly
Not searching before asking — check docs, forum, and Stack Overflow first
Being afraid to contribute — documentation fixes are as valuable as code changes
